sloka: एवमुक्त्वा दशग्रीवो मुनिं तमभिवाद्य च ।प्रययौ दक्षिणामाशां प्रविष्टः सह मन्त्रिभिः ।। ७.२०.२६ ॥
transliteration: evamuktvā daśagrīvo muniṁ tamabhivādya ca ।prayayau dakṣiṇāmāśāṁ praviṣṭaḥ saha mantribhiḥ ।। 7.20.26 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, I have now indeed set out towards the city of the king of the dead, and I shall unite with death the one who causes distress to living beings.
